name: Control Freaks Hawaii Inc.
old_description: Control Freaks Hawaii is proud to serve residential and commercial clients throughout Kailua-Kona, Hilo, Waimea, and surrounding communities on the Big Island. Our team specializes in creating technology systems that integrate seamlessly into your space and remain reliable year-round.
about:
Control Freaks Hawaii Inc. is based in Kahului, Maui, with a second office in Kurtistown on the Big Island. The company serves residential and commercial clients across the Hawaiian Islands, including Maui, the Big Island, Lanai, Molokai, Oahu, and Kauai.

The firm designs and installs integrated smart home and commercial automation systems. Its services span multi-room audio, home theater, lighting control, motorized window treatments, security, outdoor entertainment, and whole-home automation. It works with platforms such as Control4, Crestron, Lutron, Sonos, and Ketra, and collaborates with builders, architects, and designers from the early design phase. Post-installation support packages are offered to clients.

The client base includes luxury homeowners, second-home owners, and commercial operators in hospitality such as hotels, spas, and condo associations. Trade professionals — builders, architects, and interior designers — regularly engage the company for technology infrastructure planning.

Control Freaks Hawaii emphasizes its Home Technology Association (HTA) certification as a third-party validation of technical competence and service quality. The company highlights personalized design, local community ties, fast turnaround, and ongoing communication as core differentiators.
